title: A sprint item that rewords a doc the goal research's tested rows quote carries the _self eval file in its touches
goal: When a sprint's goal research lands rows in kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv whose expect_text quotes a kb/_self doc, each committed sibling whose touches name that doc gets the eval file in its touches (or precheck warns before its claim), so a reworded line moves its row in the same item instead of failing the landing's eval. Found in the SP-djl7za6x retrospective: BG-geepi6yv rewrote tools.md's section-window sentence and its land stopped at rag.py eval on two rows ST-5jqqzrgy had just added.
